questions.stem: Which agricultural practice is a major cause of eutrophication in rivers and lakes?

options.text: Excessive use of fertilisers containing nitrates and phosphates

questions.explanation: Excessive use of nitrate and phosphate fertilisers is a major cause of eutrophication. When it rains, these nutrients dissolve in water and run off into rivers and lakes, where they stimulate rapid algae growth. Careful application of fertilisers and buffer zones near waterways can help prevent this.
